theEndOfSeasons.title: Scenario I: The End of Seasons

intro.title: Scenario I: The End of Seasons
intro.part1:
Fifteen years ago, renowned Italian architect Signor Elio Varelli made his way to Arkham with a mind to construct a palatial estate in which to live out his twilight years. When Varelli passed unexpectedly shortly after the mansion’s completion, its ostentatious splendor fell into almost immediate disrepair. What should have been a masterpiece estate from one of Europe's finest architects very quickly became a colossal, sagging eyesore at the top of French Hill.

Reborn this year as the Hotel Seasons, the estate extends now a warm invitation to travelers along the Eastern Seaboard, promising luxury beyond compare. When you enter the hotel's lobby and take in the luxurious shades of its red and gold decor, you find that the establishment looks very much like the palace that Varelli had always meant it to be. The hotel's concierge efficiently verifies your reservations and offers a gracious escort to its ground-floor restaurant, the Trattoria del Parche. He says nothing about the identity of your mysterious dinner companion, and merely encourages you to enjoy the floor show until they make themselves known.

Inside, the restaurant is alive with activity. A dance troupe pirouettes on a nearby stage; a graceful performance for an audience that appears much more interested in their own food. The buzz of conversation dominates the atmosphere, the loudest of which comes from a rowdy party of diners seated nearby.

Ten rough-faced diners crowd around the nearby table, their voices raised as they engage in drunken one-upmanship. Seated at the table’s head is an elderly couple, elegantly attired —but clearly inebriated. You've been in Arkham long enough to recognize the O’Bannion gang when you see them.
intro.part2:
Before you can entertain that train of thought any further, the Maitre d’ bustles over to your table to make a fuss about taking your drink orders. Once he shuffles away, you are finally left to settle into your seat.

You realize that you're a little nervous. The anticipation of your mysterious companion’s arrival continues to build with each passing moment, and it’s hard not to wonder just what kind of excitement the rest of your evening will hold in store.
intro.underworld: The elderly man at the head of the table is no stranger to you. Declan O'Doyle is an enforcer for the O’Bannion gang, notorious for his efficiency and ruthlessness. You've heard rumors for months about a rift forming between him and Naomi O’Bannion, the gang's de facto leader, but from where you're sitting Declan looks like he’s doing just fine. You don’t recognize his companion, the older woman at his side with an aura of quiet gravitas. The way she carries herself suggests she’s every bit as formidable as Declan is.

rules.title: Locations in the Hotel Seasons
rules.body:
As the investigators travel through the Hotel Seasons, they will be instructed to both add and remove locations from play. When a location is removed from play, set it aside, out of play. A location that has been set aside in this way may return to play if another card effect instructs you to do so unless it has been removed from the game or placed in the victory display.

If you are instructed to remove a location from the game or place it in the victory display, it cannot be returned to play under any circumstances. If a card effect instructs you to put a card that has been removed from the game in play, ignore any text that references that specific location and resolve the rest of the instruction text as closely as possible.

When a location is removed from play while playing The End of Seasons, discard any attachments and clues on those locations. Move any enemies at those locations to the revealed location in play furthest from all investigators, unless otherwise directed.
